svg.title: keepcode, open source Windows app: finds every project on your computer that is not backed up and saves it to private GitHub repositories in one click
svg.text: An app that finds every project on your computer that is
not backed up, and saves it to private GitHub repositories
in one click, without touching your files or branches.
